description: A vocal channel with preamp gain, denoising, pitch correction, distortion and OTT compression.

controls.action: Connect a microphone and tap Start. Headphones are recommended.
Adjust gain on Main; dynamic microphones such as an SM58 often need 30–45 dB.
Cycle Main, Denoise, OTT and Distortion.
Adjust the four parameters on the current page.
Reset that parameter to its default.
Cycle to the next page.
Cycle through major and minor tuning keys.
Toggle the current module: Tune, Denoise, OTT or Distortion.
Jump directly to a page.
Choose Clean, Radio, Hard Tune or Distortion.
Input gain: 0–60 dB, in 3 dB steps.
Pitch-correction amount: 0–100%; higher values pull harder toward the target.
Tuning speed: 0–100%; lower values sound more gradual.
Output volume: 0–120%.
Spectral reduction amount: 0–100%; excessive reduction may affect breath sounds.
Noise-learning threshold: −80 to −20 dB. Audio below it during pauses is treated as noise.
Gate depth: 0–100%, controlling attenuation during pauses.
Release: 20–600 ms. Short values may pump; long values leave a longer tail.
Shared three-band compression threshold: −50 to 0 dB.
Upward compression: raise quiet detail.
Downward compression: reduce loud peaks.
Compressor speed: fast is tighter, slow is looser.
Drive into soft clipping: 0–100%.
Low-pass tone: 500 Hz–9 kHz; higher is brighter.
Dry/distorted mix.
Asymmetry bias: 0–100%, adding even harmonics.

sections.title: Tuning and key
sections.text: The top display shows detected pitch and its correction target. A check mark means it is on target. Correction works on monophonic vocals; chords, drums and noise can confuse detection. Toggle Tune off on Main when needed.

sections.title: Audio and latency
sections.text: The pitch-analysis window is 10.7 ms and DSP processing is about 11 ms; total latency depends on device I/O. Spectral denoising learns the background during pauses, while the gate reduces residual noise. Set the threshold near the noise floor, then speak and pause. High preamp gain also amplifies noise. Use headphones to avoid feedback.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Parameters, current page, tuning key and module switches save automatically. Exiting releases audio input and output.
